text:
emma (AE): starting a new POC thread for OrionTech — they want SSO (SAML) + SCIM group sync + tenant domain lock. aiming for a 2-week POC next Mon. who can own blockers/pricing?
emma (AE): attached a short security questionnaire and their SAML metadata link. cc @raj for setup, @luke for sec responses, @jordan for SOW/pricing.
raj (SE): I can own config. quick: SP-initiated or IdP-initiated? need IdP entityID and ACS.
emma (AE): OrionTech prefers SP-initiated. I have their metadata.
luke (Infosec): questionnaire highlights: assertion signing alg, NameID format, assertion TTL, replay protection, and domain ownership proof for tenant binding. do they require customer-managed certs/HSM?
raj (SE): For POCs we usually use our SP cert (short-lived). We support customer certs if required. SCIM: they want group push + map department->team tag. incremental sync needed?
emma (AE): yes incremental plus soft-delete handling. they also asked about typical deprovision latency.
jordan (CS): Drafting a POC SOW: include SCIM incremental, group mappings, 2-week window, optional Dedicated quote. Pricing: recommend giving evaluation credits for connector work.
luke (Infosec): tenant lock: our standard domain-verification is DNS TXT at apex. they use managed DNS via vendor, could delay start if they need internal approvals to add TXT. potential blocker.
raj (SE): alternative: run POC with manual tenant binding + IP allowlist for the window. note in SOW as temporary, not for prod.
emma (AE): timeline: need answers by Fri EOD to start Mon. actions: raj -> SAML metadata + SCIM mapping + incremental config; luke -> questionnaire answers + domain verification doc; jordan -> SOW + POC pricing; emma -> confirm IdP entityID/ACS and DNS admin contact.
raj (SE): quick SCIM mapping sample I'll paste in gdoc, inline example: `{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],"mappings":[{"source":"department","target":"urn:company:attrs:orgPath"}]}`
raj (SE): SAML sample: SP-ACS = https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs , SP-entityID = https://redwood.example.com/saml/metadata . we support rsa-sha256 signatures and encrypted assertions.
luke (Infosec): answers summary: signing alg = rsa-sha256, NameID = email-address or transient, assertion TTL = 5m recommended, replay protection = enabled, audit logs = 90d (can extend), customer-managed KMS/HSM = enterprise only + ATO. Domain-proof = DNS TXT at apex required for tenant lock.
jordan (CS): SOW ETA tomorrow AM. I'll include manual allowlist fallback and clause that full tenant lock requires DNS TXT verification before production. also include a clause for connector fees waived during POC, with credits if they convert within 30d.
emma (AE): OrionTech asked about SCIM connector pricing separate from API billing. propose: include in enterprise plan; for POC cover connector under evaluation credits; if they convert, first-month connector fee waived.
raj (SE): I'll run a staging dry-run and post logs. staging-bot will update.
staging-bot: deploy started: scim-provisioner v1.13 -> staging cluster.
raj (SE): deploy ok. sample log: SUCCESS user=amiller@oriontech.com -> groups=[eng,platform]. more details in gdoc.
luke (Infosec): if they push for tenant verification earlier, escalate their DNS admin to eng-ops for faster record provisioning.
emma (AE): I'll loop in their DNS contact now. thanks all :thumbsup:
